construct: the CLOSED combobox trigger - `justify-content: space-between` pushing a value label and a two-border chevron box to opposite ends of a bordered row
why: The closed state is the combobox a designer actually sees 99% of the time, and `space-between` is the whole reason the chevron is at the far right rather than next to the text. The chevron is drawn from two real borders rather than a pseudo-element glyph on purpose: `::before { content }` is already pinned REFUSED (pseudo-content-glyph), and this case is about the trigger's LAYOUT, not about re-measuring that wall.

canvas.note: primaryAxisAlignItems SPACE_BETWEEN on the trigger frame

mustHave: the trigger is a single bordered row with a rounded outline
the value text sits at the left end and the chevron at the right end, with empty space between them
the chevron is a small mark near the right inner edge, not adjacent to the text
the trigger shows no list of options
